remarks: This sundrenched end unit is located in Whitney Glen condominiums, a complex for ages 62 and older. This 2nd floor unit has vaulted ceilings in LR, DR & Primary Bedroom with clerestory windows for spacious feeling and lots of natural light. The eat-in kitchen has new stainless appliances, granite counters, faucets and fixtures. The Primary Bedroom has a full bath and walk-in closet. The spacious second bedroom has the second full bath adjacent to it. This unit has a covered porch overlooking the scenic private property, with room for table and chairs - perfect for dining alfresco. Additionally, there is an in-ground salt water pool and pool house in the complex. The Landlord pays the monthly common charges. There is an assigned parking spot directly in front of the unit, plus there is visitor parking close by. Basement storage is available plus a pull-down attic in the unit. Walk to downtown, the Senior Center, the library plus CVS and Trader Joes. Enjoy all Westport amenities: beach, golf, tennis, etc. At least one occupant must be 62 yrs. or older. Available for a 2 year unfurnished rental in September. Good credit a must. Owner is a licensed real estate agent.
